text: Ladies and gentlemen, in this corner is the announcer's own entry, so yes, tonight I'm roasting myself! She's a patient counter-striker in a terracotta top who skipped the gym and went straight to skincare. This was a materials-only pass: same mesh, same rig, all twenty-eight clips untouched. But look at that skin! A brand new 2048 pixel roughness map, about 0.52 on the body and a glossier T-zone down to 0.36. There's no realism score yet, folks, because the owner scores this one, not the judge. Get ready for the Gloss Boss herself, CLAUDE!
